title: BPSC 70th CCE Marks 2026 – Out
vacancyDetails: Marks sheet available for 70th CCE candidates; final result was declared earlier for ~2035 posts
qualification: Graduation from a recognized university (post-wise as per BPSC 70th notification)
ageLimit: Minimum 20/21/22 years as per post; maximum as per BPSC rules (as on 01-08-2024)
selectionProcess: Prelims → Mains → Interview → Final Result → Marks Sheet
documentsRequired: 69th/70th OTR Username & Password to view Ank Patra (marks sheet)
howToApply:
1. Visit https://bpsconline.bihar.gov.in or bpsc.bih.nic.in
2. Login with 69th/70th OTR credentials
3. Open Marks Sheet / Ank Patra section (from 22 July 2026)
4. Download and print marks for record
5. Contact BPSC only through official channels for discrepancies
shortDescription: BPSC has enabled 70th CCE Marks Sheet 2026 from 22 July 2026. Candidates can view Ank Patra using OTR login on BPSC online portal.
content:
Bihar Public Service Commission (BPSC) has released the facility to download 70th Combined Competitive Examination marks sheet.

As per official notice, candidates can view marks from 22 July 2026 using 69th and 70th OTR username and password.

Notes

  • Final result for the 70th CCE was declared earlier (around June 2026)
  • Marks sheet is for transparency and candidate record
  • Portal: bpsconline.bihar.gov.in
